caseStudies.after_state: Within 1 year of launching their new website and implementing a digital-first strategy, we doubled their revenue. We eliminated “shooting from the hip” marketing decisions and redirected budget toward performance-driven channels. Strongest ROI came from Meta campaigns, which we aggressively optimized and scaled. We reallocated billboard spend into SEO and GEO, significantly improving search visibility. Marketing became measurable, scalable, and aligned with capacity.
caseStudies.unique_mechanism: Eliminated guesswork, reallocated spend to performance-driven digital channels.

caseStudies.after_state: Within 1 year of working together, Capstone expanded from 4 locations to 15 locations. Within the first 4 months of launching the new website, they generated over 1,000 inbound leads, and made all their intial investment back (with profit leftover)

Overall, the company has grown approximately 50% year-over-year since engagement.
caseStudies.unique_mechanism: Out-positioned PE-backed competitors through strategic SEO/GEO, not outspending.
